title: The Kingfisher
summary: A kingfisher who loved solitude built her nest upon a high sea-cliff, seeking safety from hunters and beasts of the earth....
full_text:
A kingfisher who loved solitude built her nest upon a high sea-cliff, seeking safety from hunters and beasts of the earth.

While she was away gathering fish, a violent ocean storm arose. Towering tidal waves swept up the rock face, smashing her nest and drowning her fledglings.

Returning to the ruins, the grief-stricken bird wept: "In fleeing the perils of the land, I sought refuge with the sea, and the ocean has proved far more merciless than the earth!"
moral: In fleeing perils of the land, beware lest you build your nest where the waves can reach.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
